row:
Alyse Aguirre, founder of Revival Movement UT & Revival Equine is a Licensed Massage Therapist, NASM Certified Personal Trainer, Human Movement & Performance Specialist and FRC Certified Mobility Specialist and is here to provide simple, short videos describing various exercises. This channel is created primarily for Alyse's clients as a reference for programming but is hopefully a great resource to others that may find it helpful!
Visit our website if you are interested in more information including recipes.
Alyse offers remote online training and programming, specializing in mobility, strength and conditioning. She has trained a wide variety of people, including general population, high school/collage athletes, models, race car drivers, equestrians, endurance athletes, cross fitters, veterans and also does work with the horse and rider pair, helping them move better as a team.
Thanks for watching!
Subscribe to my channel for more videos!
